nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Sometimes I think Evan is more afraid of losing me than he is capable of loving me.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: And I understand him. I'm afraid too.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: But I don't want us to wake up one day and realize that we've spent all this time just holding each other in place.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: I want us to be able to be together and still remain separate people. Maybe that's what real love is.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: If I leave, I want him to know: I'm not running away from him. I just want us to have a future where we can both breathe.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: She wrote that when she was angry with you.
